question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN age >= 20 AND age <= 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN age >= 30 AND age <= 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN age >= 40 AND age <= 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN age >= 50 AND age <= 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END as age_category,
  COUNT(*) as user_count
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    user_id,
    birth_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CURRENT_DATE, CAST(birth_date AS DATE)))::INTEGER as age
  FROM mst_users
  GROUP BY user_id, birth_date
)
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY 
  CASE age_category
    WHEN '20s' THEN 1
    WHEN '30s' THEN 2
    WHEN '40s' THEN 3
    WHEN '50s' THEN 4
    WHEN 'others' THEN 5
  END
